procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial assessment in this session; no spawned, resumed or forked critic, and no peer or producer records consulted. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, compact addendum/method/adapter and ratio policy; verified their declared byte pins and all five pinned artifact manifests without following embedded paths. The packet declares no supplied source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so both prerequisite arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact PNGs with tools.view_image(detail:original), emitted with original image detail, in packet order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same three-view order. Finished every one of those opens before beginning the first poster-copy transcription or any judgment/score. First readings below come from the visible posters, with soft layout wraps retained; they were not populated from the required-copy fields. One genuine M4 title word-space ambiguity triggered one additional opening of its exact pinned native PNG. During that sole revisit a read-only ink-column check of the same native title confirmed a 14-pixel gap before 집 versus 6 and 5 pixels between the earlier syllables; both first and revisit readings are retained. No other poster revisits and no generated, edited, cropped or substituted assets. Hash/PNG-header checks were byte verification, never evidence of actual viewing. All natives are 1672x941 opaque RGB; 16:9 is accepted by the predeclared single-edge height-rounding rule (941 versus 940.5, error 0.5 pixel), not mathematical equality. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180. Session identity is unobservable here and remains null; no tool-event or runtime-session ID is invented.
